segments.content:
Rekindling the Green Years Chapter 46: Hua Xiuxiu's Little Ambition

At four-thirty in the evening, Li Luo sat at his desk and took the collected physical examination forms from Hua Xiuxiu.

He flipped through them one by one, and after about a minute, handed the forms back to Hua Xiuxiu.

"Take the physical examination forms to Teacher Kong," Li Luo said. "Zhu Yufei and I will take some people to get the military training uniforms."

"Alright." Hua Xiuxiu didn't think much of it and, as Li Luo instructed, took the forms upstairs to find Teacher Kong.

Li Luo then called out to Zhu Yufei, "Get a few guys. We're going to get the military training uniforms."

"You got it," Zhu Yufei replied, laughingly slinging an arm around his deskmate Zhang Guohuang's neck. He then shouted to a few other boys nearby, "Let's go, let's go, time to move the military training uniforms."

Some of the boys had just finished their physicals after waiting in line for over an hour. Already a bit tired, they sat at their desks and pretended not to hear.

But just then, Yan Zhusheng, who was nearby, also stood up and walked over to Li Luo's side.

Li Luo gave her a surprised look. "What are you tagging along for?"

"I'm the PE committee member," Yan Zhusheng said, blinking, her expression a little lost. "Am I not supposed to come?"

Li Luo glanced over at the situation on Zhu Yufei's side, then smiled. "Then let's go together."

With that, Li Luo walked over to Zhu Yufei, patted his shoulder, and said in a deliberately louder voice, "Both PE committee members, come with me and bring some people. We need a few more of the other boys."

The moment he finished speaking, a group of boys stood up in unison, all feigning as if they had been about to leave anyway, and were the first to walk out of the classroom.

Yan Zhusheng was stunned for a moment. Seeing that most of the boys had stood up, she couldn't help but ask, "Should I call the girls then?"

"Let the girls rest in the classroom." Li Luo chuckled to himself, thinking how easy it was to fool high school boys.

Of course, even if they were reluctant, if Li Luo, the class president, had really insisted, they were all classmates and would have certainly come along.

It just wouldn't have been as effective as it was now.

The group of them trooped downstairs, heading toward the warehouse on the sports field.

At the same time, Hua Xiuxiu had arrived at the fifth-floor office. She found Kong Junxiang and handed him the forms, "Teacher Kong, our class's physical examination forms have all been collected."

"Good." Kong Junxiang took the forms and then asked, "Have the height data for our class's students been compiled?"

"Huh?" Hua Xiuxiu froze for a second, not understanding. "We need to compile the height data?"

"Didn't Li Luo tell you?" Kong Junxiang looked puzzled. "Where is he?"

"He took some people to get the military training uniforms."

"Then how could he not have compiled the height data?" Kong Junxiang said, half-laughing. "Otherwise, when they get to the warehouse, they won't know how many of each size to get."

"But it seems he really didn't tally it..." Hua Xiuxiu recalled, then said helplessly.

Li Luo had only taken the forms and counted them to see if the number was correct. Hua Xiuxiu hadn't seen him compile any height data at all.

After all, judging by the speed at which Li Luo flipped through the forms, he had at most glanced at each one.

"This careless?" Kong Junxiang was at a loss for whether to laugh or cry. He took a blank sheet of paper from his drawer and handed a pen to Hua Xiuxiu. "I'll read out the heights. You divide them into 10cm ranges and use tally marks to record them."

"O-Okay." Hua Xiuxiu hurriedly took the pen and began to write on the paper.

It took the two of them a few minutes. After finishing the tally, Kong Junxiang stood up. "Let's go. I'm going to hand in the examination forms and drop by to see how Li Luo is doing."

Hua Xiuxiu picked up the paper with the compiled data and nodded, thinking to herself that Li Luo was, as expected, not as suited to be class president as she was.

So, on the way downstairs, Hua Xiuxiu couldn't help but ask Kong Junxiang, "Teacher Kong."

"Hm?"

"After the military training ends, will we have to elect other class officers?"

"Yes, what about it?"

"Well... will positions like class president, vice president, and PE committee member be up for re-election too?"

Hearing this, Kong Junxiang turned his head to look at Hua Xiuxiu.

He had expected her to look down and avoid his gaze out of shyness, but to his surprise, the young girl met his stare directly, without a hint of guilt.

This made him raise an eyebrow. He then nodded with a smile. "Of course. There will definitely be a re-election."

"Choosing the four of you for these roles was just for the military training."

"Once the military training is over, your classmates will likely have their own opinions on whether you're suited for these positions."

After confirming there would be a re-election, Hua Xiuxiu's eyes lit up. Her heart was instantly refilled with fighting spirit, and she resolved to perform well during the military training.

Following Teacher Kong to the Class Eight classroom on the third floor, Hua Xiuxiu glanced inside and saw that Li Luo and the others had not yet returned.

Just as she was thinking this, a set of footsteps sounded from the stairwell.

Led by Li Luo, more than a dozen boys, plus the lone girl Yan Zhusheng, returned to the classroom in a large group.

Each person was carrying several military training uniforms, which they placed on the teacher's podium.

Seeing that Li Luo and the others had really brought back the uniforms, Hua Xiuxiu rushed forward and asked with a frown, "You didn't even compile our class's height data. How did you get the uniforms? You couldn't have just grabbed them randomly, right?"

Li Luo gave Hua Xiuxiu a surprised look, then noticed Kong Junxiang behind her. "I did compile it. Didn't I look at them?"

"You call a quick glance compiling?" Hua Xiuxiu looked at him speechlessly, holding out the piece of paper with the class height data. "I just compiled this with Teacher Kong. Check if the numbers are correct. If not, hurry up and exchange them."

"Don't worry." Li Luo didn't take the paper, instead pointing at the uniforms on the podium. "150 to 160, 6 people."

Hua Xiuxiu blinked and looked down at the paper. It was indeed 6 people.

"160 to 170, 18 people."

"170 to 180, 11 people."

"Over 180, 5 people."

"The numbers should be correct, right?" Li Luo asked with a smile.

"Um..." Hua Xiuxiu clutched the paper in her hand tightly, feeling a bit lost for a moment. "When did you compile this?"

"Ahem... this isn't your fault. It was my mistake for not explaining it clearly." In front of Teacher Kong, Li Luo didn't make things difficult for her. Instead, he explained, "I have a pretty good memory, remember? I basically memorize the data after one look."

"Memorized it with just one glance?!" Hua Xiuxiu's eyes widened slightly, still finding it hard to believe.

Memorizing something at a glance, she could understand. But to scan the heights of forty people and then compile that data was a bit too absurd, wasn't it?

Is your brain made of a computer?

"You'll get used to it. Don't be so surprised all the time," Li Luo said, then added, "You can handle distributing the uniforms. Have the students come up and get them group by group."

"Oh..." Hua Xiuxiu replied subconsciously, then caught herself. "...Okay."

Seeing this, Kong Junxiang didn't say much more. He just smiled at the scene, then left with the examination forms to hand them in.

Yan Zhusheng followed Li Luo back to her seat, then suddenly looked at him with curiosity and asked, "Can you really memorize it all with just one look?"

"Of course."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded, then glanced down at her own flat chest, frowning slightly in silence, looking a little unhappy.
